rules: CPU resource/ISA/ABI/patch compatibility must be audited before update
shared ggml source affects other routes; GPU existing qualifications must not be silently signed
old Native WIN is relative to locked mature peer; updating peer requires version fencing/reconciliation, not forced self-kernel benchmarking

evidence_limits: public API and source metadata only; no new weight payload download or model execution
repository downloads do not establish per-variant popularity rank
new variant physical mixtures have not all been header-audited
file list absence does not prove no embedded MTP/DSpark tensors
revision mismatch may be reconciled via immutable per-file/header identities rather than rerunning unchanged math
no upstream-missing verdict or self-written math authorization is inferred

performance_policy.per_operator_provider_winner_P1: not required for a single mature carrier when no optimization/SOTA claim is made
performance_policy.P0: required: no hidden hot compilation, repeated full dequantization, per-submit metadata/weight packing, global serialization or unnecessary conversions
performance_policy.delegation_cost: one batched ordinary Direct/Graph versus same upstream complete program acceptance after immutable candidate, if required by closure card; no per-variant repeated races
performance_policy.reuse: identical tensor/program/ABI/toolchain scope may reuse qualified evidence
performance_policy.defer: new self-provider contests and instrument redesign

gap: CPU carrier; Apple MLX qualification is not CPU qualification
